text:
Jorge: Heads-up folks, AcmeSys POC is blocked by procurement. They want a signed MSA + DPA and a PO before we spin up the dedicated cluster. Their procurement email asks for net45, HSM/KMS support, and a 5-year log retention clause.
Priya (Legal): Please paste the redline. Immediate red flags: customer-supplied DPA contains broad audit rights and a clause transferring IP outright. We typically convert IP transfer into a limited license. Also prefer "third-party SOC2 audit" instead of unfettered on-site access.
Jorge: Pasting link to redline now. Also they asked: "Can you accept on-site audits at short notice?"
Nina (Security): Short-notice on-site audits are risky. Proposed compromise: allow independent audits by accredited firms with 30 days notice and scoped to relevant systems. For log retention: 5 years is long; can offer 12-36 months depending on plan, but 5y needs legal & storage ops approval. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys in Private deployments but will need an onboarding addendum and a one-time integration fee.
Omar (Finance): Net45 can be approved for POCs under $25k but requires a billing exception ticket and a PO before provisioning. Who will own the exception? Also need to confirm invoice cadence (one-time vs monthly).
Jorge: POC total is $18k (one-time) + optional $5k KMS setup. I'll propose: Net45 (PO required), KMS add-on fee, and 12-month retention baseline. Draft order form snippet: ```
Product: Redwood Dedicated - POC
Config: 1x A100-class, 30 days
Fees: $18,000 one-time setup
KMS onboarding: $5,000 one-time
Payment: Net45 (PO required)
```
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0xabc123 sent to procurement@acmesys.com, status: sent.
Priya (Legal): That snip looks fine. If they're using their DPA, I need to do a line-by-line. For audit language, suggest: "Customer may engage certified auditors subject to Redwoods reasonable security and confidentiality requirements, with 30 days prior notice; scope limited to logs and controls relevant to the Service." Also add KMS appendix reference.
Nina (Security): KMS onboarding checklist for ENG (paste): ```
- Customer provides a cross-account role with least privilege
- Rotation schedule: managed by customer, coordinated with Redwood
- Onboarding window: 48-72 hours
- Fallback: Redwood-managed key for initial provisioning if needed
- No SSH or direct key export allowed
```
Omar (Finance): I'll start FIN ticket and pre-authorize the net45 exception pending PO. Ticket FIN-4609 opened, owner: Omar. Please include negotiated cap on liability if they proposed liquidated damages.
Jorge: They did propose LDs tied to uptime. I flagged it as unacceptable without limits. Priya, can legal propose cap language?
Priya (Legal): Don't accept open-ended LDs. Propose a capped remedy equal to the fees paid in the prior 12 months or a fixed cap (e.g., $50k) whichever is lower. Also require Finance sign-off for anything over $250k liability.
DocuSign Bot: Recipient procurement@acmesys.com viewed envelope 0xabc123 at 09:42 UTC.
Jorge: I'll upload our redline: change audit to scoped third-party, limit retention to 12 months in DPA but offer 36 months as a paid option, add KMS appendix and the onboarding fee. Sending to @Priya (Legal) for quick review.
Priya (Legal): Reviewing now. If we can get audit language + KMS appendix in place, I'll sign off to enable provisioning.
Omar (Finance): Once Priya confirms, I'll clear FIN-4609 and release provisioning hold. Need PO number in the thread before we provision.
Jorge: Sounds good. Will update with uploaded redline and PO when received. Thanks everyone :rocket:
